summary: First-iteration e2e testing of J B KEER Adhesive Consultant landing page. Backend: 6/6 pytest tests passed (root, lead create success, validation errors for invalid email/short name/missing project_type, list leads with no _id leak). Frontend: all data-testids present, all sections render at 1920/768/390 viewports, nav/hero/service-card/mobile CTAs all scroll to #contact, mobile menu toggle works, empty-form validation displays 5 inline field errors, and form submission with Radix Select succeeds (form-success state + Sonner toast confirmed). No real bugs found.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py serialises datetime via .isoformat() before insert and re-parses on read — works, but consider letting motor handle datetime natively for consistency.
EmailStr from pydantic depends on email-validator; already declared in requirements — keep that pinned to avoid runtime ImportError.
Lead listing limit is 500; fine for MVP but add pagination once leads grow.
seed_data_creation: Created a few TEST_-prefixed lead records via POST /api/leads during testing; safe to leave or clean later.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Radix Select handling: click [data-testid='form-project-type'] then use page.get_by_role('option', name='<Option>') — do NOT use get_by_text since service-card headings share names like 'Industrial Adhesives'. Backend external URL works; tests use REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from frontend/.env. Form success shows [data-testid='form-success'] plus Sonner toast at top-center.
rca of the issue: n/a — no app bugs. Initial Playwright run reported 3 false-positive failures: (a) service-card/mobile CTA scroll checks where the smooth-scroll hadn't completed in 800ms and the bounding-rect heuristic returned false; (b) Radix Select option click via get_by_text matched the in-page service card heading instead of the dropdown option. Re-test with role=option selector confirmed full success.
